blocks.text: Hum jaante hain ke jab charge q wala particle potential V_A wale point A se potential V_B wale point B tak electrostatic equilibrium mein rehte hue jata hai, to us ki potential energy mein tabdeeli:
Agar equilibrium qaim rakhne ke liye charge par koi bahar ki force na lage, to P.E. ki yeh tabdeeli K.E. ki tabdeeli ban kar saamne aati hai (charge tez ho jata hai).
Maan lein particle par charge q = e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C hai (yani ek electron ya proton ka charge).
To charge jo energy hasil karega:

blocks.latex: \Delta K.E. = q\,\Delta V = e\,\Delta V = (1.6 \times 10^{-19}\ \text{C})(\Delta V)

blocks.text: 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J energy ko ek electron-volt kehte hain aur 1 eV likhte hain.

blocks.title: Electron-volt
blocks.text: Woh energy jo ek electron ek volt ka potential difference paar karte hue hasil karta (acquire) ya khota (lose) hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Joule atoms aur electrons ke liye bohat bari unit hai, is liye wahan eV istemal hota hai. Yaad rakhein: eV energy ki unit hai, potential difference ki nahi.

blocks.title: Example 9.6
blocks.problem: 2e charge wala particle 3.0 V ke potential difference se guzarta hai. Woh kitni energy hasil (acquire) karta hai?

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka sawal "energy required" (darkaar energy) likhta hai; murad "energy acquired" (hasil ki gayi energy) hai, jaisa hal (solution) mein likha hai.

blocks.prompt: Electron volt potential difference ki unit hai ya energy ki (short question 9.4)? 100 volts ka potential difference ek electron par kitna kaam karta hai (MCQ 9.4)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh energy ki unit hai: 1 eV woh energy hai jo electron 1 V paar kar ke hasil karta ya khota hai, yani 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J. Potential difference ki unit volt hai. 100 V par kaam W = e × 100 V = 100 eV (option d) = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁷ J.

items: ΔU = qΔV (9.24); bahar ki force na ho to yeh K.E. ban jati hai.
1 eV = electron ki 1 V paar karne par hasil ya khoi energy = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J (9.25); energy ki unit.
Example 9.6: 2e charge 3.0 V se 6.0 eV = 9.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J hasil karta hai.
